answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the ember index resolves every citation against the spiral checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. The per-identity price is 106 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
